name: Submission
description: You attempt a forceful grapple on a target. Make a melee attack, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit, but taking a quarter of the damage dealt in recoil. On a hit, the target is grappled. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a {save}. While a creature is grappled, this move can be activated again as a bonus action with an automatic hit, dealing 2d6 {type} damage with a quarter of the damage dealt in typeless recoil.
